# BAD-011 — Cloud line-marking with hosted diarizing speech-to-text, the first cloud feature Plus sells

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 11, phase 2. The Plus subscription is built end to end server-side (migration 0017: private.subscriptions, private.subscription_payments, private.cloud_jobs, claim_cloud_job with a flat 30-a-month allowance; the Polar webhook's lifecycle) and is deliberately not sold. Eric's call on 2026-08-22: sell it once there is cloud compute to sell, because a subscription granting only what the $10 one-time grants is a worse way to buy the same thing. Cloud line-marking is the first such feature. As of 2026-09-14 nothing in server/supabase/functions, src or renderer reads cloud_jobs.

What it is: hosted speech-to-text that marks a scene's lines, so anyone can auto-mark without installing whisper.cpp. Hosted STT prices at roughly $0.0003 to $0.006 a minute, a fraction of a cent for a five-minute scene, and needs no worker to host.

Decisions to make first (a research spike, then Eric):
- A diarizing provider. Plain Whisper returns no speaker labels, so every segment lands in one character lane and the real work is left undone. Compare diarization quality on real movie and TV scenes, price, data retention and training-use terms.
- The privacy-policy line: this is the first time user audio leaves the device. site/privacy.html now exists and needs the paragraph.

Build notes: cloud jobs ride the shipped jobs tray (src/jobs.js) and follow Finish's survives-leaving rule; a job is committed when its credit is reserved, and Cancel releases the reservation, never spends it. It is a second provider behind the creator's existing auto-mark, not a second button. The render service on Cloud Run (#313) is the existing precedent for hosted compute if a worker turns out to be needed. The launch order after it works is in TODO 11 (Polar SKU, product id env vars, checkout URL placeholder in renderer/index.html, flag on for one account, then site/).

Read first: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-18-tiered-cloud-generation-design.md (its take-limit section is superseded by 2026-08-19-free-tier-analytics-and-updates-design.md).
